text: You have the right to perform your duty, but not to the fruits of your actions.
The soul is neither born, nor does it die. It is not slain when the body is slain.
A person can rise through the efforts of his own mind, or draw himself down in the same manner.
Whatever happened, happened for the good. Whatever is happening, is happening for the good.
The mind is restless and difficult to restrain, but it is subdued by practice and detachment.
Set thy heart upon thy work, but never on its reward.
There is neither this world, nor the world beyond, nor happiness for the one who doubts.
When meditation is mastered, the mind is unwavering like the flame of a lamp in a windless place.
The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead.
Change is the law of the universe. What you think of as death is, in fact, transformation.
The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me.
You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean in a drop.
The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
Wherever you are, be totally there.
Silence is the language of God; all else is poor translation.
Yoga is the journey of the self, through the self, to the self.
What you seek is seeking you.
The soul always knows what to do to heal itself. The challenge is to silence the mind.
Be still and know that I am God.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
Deep breathing for just five minutes a day can lower cortisol and reset your nervous system.
A consistent sleep schedule does more for your health than the number of hours you sleep.
Your gut and brain are in constant conversation — what you eat shapes how you feel.
Stretching every morning improves circulation and primes your body for the day ahead.
Hydration affects mood as much as it affects the body — even mild dehydration can cause fatigue.
Sunlight within the first hour of waking helps regulate your circadian rhythm naturally.
Slow, mindful eating improves digestion and helps you recognize true fullness.
Short walks after meals can meaningfully lower blood sugar spikes.
Chronic stress shows up in the body long before it shows up in the mind. Listen early.
Laughter genuinely lowers stress hormones and boosts immune function.
Comparison is the thief of joy.
You don't have to control your thoughts. You just have to stop letting them control you.
Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.
The obstacle is the way.
You cannot pour from an empty cup. Take care of yourself first.
Not every storm comes to disrupt your life. Some come to clear your path.
Healing is not linear. Be patient with yourself.
What is meant for you will not pass you by.
The way you speak to yourself matters more than you think.
Rest is not a reward for finishing. It is a requirement for continuing.
Small steps every day lead to big changes over time.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Your only limit is the one you set yourself.
Consistency is what transforms average into excellence.
Progress, not perfection.
The body achieves what the mind believes.
Showing up is half the battle. Do it again tomorrow.
Your breath is the bridge between your body and your mind. Use it.
